D: A psychiatrist starts seeing a terrifying smiling presence after a disturbing session with a patient.
P: Serve dessert when Rose finally heads back to her childhood home.
S: the grin she can't stop seeing
Mashed potato mixed with cheddar and a little flour, rolled out, cut into rounds with two eyes and a wide smile pressed in, baked at 220C for 15 minutes until crisp.
her sister's family party in the backyard
Beef sliders smashed thin on a griddle, cheddar melted on, pickles and tomato sauce on soft rolls, piled on a party platter.
Crunchy bite-size buttermilk fried chicken pieces with a honey mustard dip. Soak 600g diced chicken thigh in 250ml buttermilk for 1 hour.
M: dinner with her fiancé, before it falls apart
Salmon fillet roasted skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes, with lemon and dill butter, crushed potatoes and green beans.
the long nights she can't sleep
Ramen noodles in chicken broth with soy, miso and ginger, topped with soft-boiled eggs cooked 6 and a half minutes, spring onion and chilli oil.
W: Vanilla sugar cookies cut into rounds, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced pale yellow with a wide red smile piped on. A little unsettling.
K: Chamomile flowers steeped 5 minutes in boiling water with a slice of lemon and a spoon of honey.

s.note: the grin she can't stop seeing
s.how: Mash 600g boiled potatoes with 80g grated cheddar, 2 tbsp flour and 20g butter. Roll out 1cm thick and cut rounds. Press in two eyes and a wide smile with a straw and spoon. Bake at 220C for 15 minutes until crisp.

Soak 600g diced chicken thigh in 250ml buttermilk for 1 hour. Toss in 150g flour seasoned with paprika, garlic powder and salt and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Serve with 4 tbsp honey mixed with 3 tbsp Dijon.

m.note: dinner with her fiancé, before it falls apart
m.how: Roast 4 salmon fillets skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes. Melt 60g butter with lemon juice and dill and spoon over. Crush 800g boiled potatoes with butter. Steam 300g green beans.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Cut rounds and bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Ice pale yellow with 300g icing sugar and pipe a wide red smile on each. A little unsettling.

d.how: Steep 4 chamomile tea bags in 1L boiling water for 5 minutes. Pour into mugs with a slice of lemon and a spoon of honey. Breathe out.
